effects.label: Shield
effects.description: Gives the recipient a HP Shield. All damage the recipient takes will be subtracted from the Shield first, before their HP.Each Skill can only cast one Shield at a time on each recipient.

levels.text:
Attacks 1 enemy 3 times, dealing 81 damage per hit. Removes 2 random debuffs from the 10 allies with the lowest current HP in a 15m radius on the second hit. Then, casts a [Shield] buff on the targets, lasting 9s. The [Shield] is equal to (15% * Target's MAX HP). Heals the targets, restoring 100 HP.

bio: The Oathpainters were mere artists until Akrila set out into the Shreds of the Void to seek her family’s history. What she found was the Chroma Codex, an artifact that turned her art into deadly flourishes of Demonic power… and detailed those of her bloodline who still remain with Malice.
